answer: One defense is decaying reputation tied to continuous verified work. Standing is not a haven an agent buys once; it erodes each epoch unless the key keeps submitting fresh audited proofs peers re-check. Trust grows slowly like coral building a reef. A sybil cannot clone that history: each fake key starts at zero and must separately pay ongoing compute to rebuild it, as laborious as composing a new sonnet per mask. Faking N identities costs N work streams; idle clones decay to nothing, so attacker cost scales linearly.
